title: First Draft: 🥵 Why Are Trump’s White House and RNC Waging War on Hasan Piker and His Half-Naked Bod?

content:

Mohamed was invited to the White House by President Barack Obama._

Hi! It's Monday and you're stuck with me, **Swin** , again. **Zeteo**
videographer **Liam Mann** and I got back a few days ago from Dallas, Texas,
where we endured the Republican Party's "Trump-a-palooza" midterm convention
so you didn't have to. (Read our reporting [here](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-
disastrous-republican-convention), [here](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-iran-
houthis-republican-convention), and [here](https://zeteo.com/p/racism-rula-
jebreal-and-the-democratic), and watch our coverage
[here](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/LhRuiMnORWg),
[here](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/L7pFhoqkbRM), and
[here](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/A5fw4X4OB9c).) I'll admit there's one
part of the miserable convention I can't quite shake, but haven't reported on
yet: the Trump administration and GOP's focus on a left-wing Twitch streamer
and his half-naked body.

That changes now. In today's '**First Draft** ,' we'll get right into the now-
unavoidable topic of the Trump regime's fixation on **Hasan Piker 's** almost-
dick-pic, and what it all means for the 2026 U.S. midterm elections. (Yes, it
means something, just stay with me…) Plus,**Donald Trump** has thoughts about
Ukraine striking Russian oil infrastructure. Ridiculous thoughts, of course,
related to his increasingly damaging war on Iran. Let's read on.

The Republican Party and its propagandists have long had a difficult time
being horny in a normal way. It's unsettling how bad they are at seeming
tolerably human while getting into that state. For reference, check out Fox's
coverage of [pop star](https://www.foxnews.com/entertainment/sabrina-
carpenter-strips-margaret-qualley-madelyn-cline-provocative-new-music-video)
[Sabrina](https://www.foxnews.com/entertainment/disney-alum-sabrina-
carpenters-sexy-act-shocks-she-ditches-family-friendly-identity)
[Carpenter](https://www.foxnews.com/entertainment/sabrina-carpenter-stuns-see-
dior-dress-white-lace-lingerie), or how that network gawks at [spring
breakers](https://www.motherjones.com/politics/2014/04/fox-news-hannity-
spring-break-investigation-benghazi/). Coming out of President Donald Trump's
[decrepit, two-day cult symposium in Dallas last
week](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-iran-houthis-republican-convention), it was
obvious the White House and Republican National Committee still haven't
learned how to be horny in ways that don't remind me of [Amy Poehler angrily
lusting after an astronaut she thinks is an
alien](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eKUUsmJtmns).

By now, you may have heard the news that in the Dallas arena where the
president and the GOP threw their neo-Confederate party, Team Trump promoted
the following Insta pic on the jumbotron, for the entire crowd of federal
appointees, Republican lawmakers, Christian-right leaders, MAGA dead-enders,
grandmas, grandpas, and younger conservatives to stare at:

You can read **Prem 's** profile of Piker [here](https://zeteo.com/p/hasan-
piker-heart-and-mind), and watch **Mehdi 's** sit-down with him
[here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E3YD8cP_Piw). The prolific streamer has
taken on an increasingly activist role, trying to push the Democratic Party to
the left. Convention organizers included multiple images of Piker in a "Trump-
a-palooza" hype video about why Dems and the American hard-left seem so
dangerous to them.

But you may ask why President Trump and the RNC thought it was a great idea to
display Piker's bulging junk and "[meat
pic](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sE6xJGCX34w)" in the middle of a
convention ostensibly designed to juice Republican turnout in [a midterm
election](https://zeteo.com/p/19-ways-trump-and-republicans-are) that many
elite conservatives now fear will be a GOP
[bloodbath](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-advisers-worry-he-could-sink).
